new_indicators.name: Programme projects completed
new_indicators.definition: Real-estate or business projects built as qualifying programme investments that are completed in a period (status actual) or expected to be completed (status projection). Breakdown category= for the type (e.g. hotel). Not approvals (cbi_projects_approved).

new_indicators.name: Programme money against its target
new_indicators.definition: Programme money in a period compared with the target, budget or programme expectation for it, as printed: the amount above or below it (currency), as a percentage of GDP (unit percent_of_gdp), as a percentage of the target (unit percent_of_target) or as a multiple of it (unit times_target). category= names the item and the direction (e.g. ima_revenue_above_target, ciu_programme_cost_below_budget). Neither level is implied; never calculated by us.
new_indicators.notes: Used for Grenada IMA collections, St Kitts CBI receipts against the IMF stand-by programme, and Saint Lucia CIU revenue, costs and deficit against budget. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

new_indicators.name: Recommended savings buffer from programme revenue, share of GDP
new_indicators.definition: Size of precautionary (stabilisation) savings built from programme revenue that a source estimates as adequate or recommends, as a percentage of GDP; value_high for a range. category= for the basis of the estimate. Status estimate. Not an actual fund balance (ndf_assets_pct_gdp, cbi_account_balance).

new_indicators.name: Investment stated for one application
new_indicators.definition: Investment or donation amount stated for one application in a source's list of individual applications (breakdown item=, route=). Not a total, not an average, and not necessarily paid.

new_indicators.name: Licence fee per agent
new_indicators.definition: Fee an agent, promoter or marketing firm pays the programme authority for its licence or marketing rights, per agent and per period, as stated in a contract or report (category= names the agent type or firm). Total fees collected go in cbi_fee_revenue.

new_indicators.name: Programme agency balance sheet
new_indicators.definition: Items of the statement of financial position of the agency that runs a programme (cash, receivables, prepayments, property plant and equipment, payables and accruals, provisions, deferred income, lease liabilities, totals, equity) at a date, and the movements in those items that the report or its notes print (additions, depreciation, amounts recognised, increases and decreases, percentage changes, working capital ratio). category= names the item; unit percent or ratio for printed changes and ratios. Accounts of the agency, not of the government fund (cbi_account_balance).
new_indicators.notes: Covers Saint Lucia CIU audited statements and summary balance sheets; percentage changes and the working capital ratio are kept as printed, never computed. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

new_indicators.name: Programme agency cash flows
new_indicators.definition: Lines of the statement of cash flows of the agency that runs a programme in a period (operating, investing and financing flows, working-capital changes, distributions to government, cash at start and end). category= names the line; outflows printed in brackets are stored as negative numbers.

new_indicators.name: Programme board meetings
new_indicators.definition: Meetings held by the board or committee that decides programme applications or oversees the programme agency, in a period.

new_indicators.name: Programme board meeting time
new_indicators.definition: Total time the programme board spent in meetings in a period, in the units printed (hours and minutes are stored as separate rows category=hours_part / minutes_part, never converted).

new_indicators.name: Programme board attendance
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of programme board meetings attended by a member (category= the member's role; names are not recorded) or the lowest attendance among members, as printed.

new_indicators.name: Programme staff with a trait
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the programme agency's staff with a stated trait or outcome (category=: e.g. professionally certified, average retention rate), as printed. Never calculated by us.

new_indicators.name: Programme staff movements
new_indicators.definition: Staff movements at the programme agency in a period: hires, resignations, terminations, promotions. Unit persons for counts; unit percent_of_movements when the source prints each type's share of all movements; unit percent for a printed change against the previous period.

new_indicators.name: Share of applications decided
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the applications received in a period that had been decided (granted or denied) by its end, as printed. Not a grant rate (applications_grant_rate).

new_indicators.name: Public cost of a programme project
new_indicators.definition: Cost to the public purse (spending, guarantees, concessions or losses) attributed to a programme-linked project, as stated by the source; category= for the project. Political statements take status claim.

new_indicators.name: Approved files awaiting issue
new_indicators.definition: Approved applications whose permit, card or certificate has not yet been issued at a date because the applicant has not completed the last steps (fee payment, biometrics, collection). Not visa-number waits (petitions_approved_awaiting_visa).

new_indicators.name: Application appointments
new_indicators.definition: In-person appointments, attendances or pre-bookings for programme applications at an office, per day or in a period (category= for per-day peak or a single booking).

new_indicators.name: Time per site visit
new_indicators.definition: Staff time per site visit or inspection of a programme entity (officer hours) or elapsed time from the visit to a determination (days), as a statistic printed by the source (category= mean, median, range). Not processing time of applications.

new_indicators.name: Share of programme businesses that are small
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of programme intermediaries or businesses (regional centers, new commercial enterprises, job-creating entities) found to be small entities under a size standard in an impact analysis, as printed; breakdown category=/sample= for group and sample.

new_indicators.name: Share of programme projects with a feature
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of programme investment projects with a stated feature (e.g. blending non-programme capital), as printed. A share of projects, not of money (rbi_investment_share).
